integrity: The analytic proof uses the weighted matrix-tree identity and eight exact two-by-two matrix inequalities. Reproducible rational/integer checks are provided, and no finite computation is used as a substitute for the all-width proof.
scientific_limitations: Complete classification only at the first vanishing frequency degree when the larger bipartition size is divisible by four; other Fourier bands and full nullities are not determined. Prior-art review is bounded; independent mathematical validation is unperformed.
title: The sharp first Walsh-zero band for spanning trees of \(K_{3,4q}\)
